<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges with retrieve_carbon_shifts to identify the aromatic region (approximately 120‑150 ppm). By counting the peaks that fall within this aromatic range, I can infer the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
